intro: The Cucumber Mint Lime (22 oz) from CAVA is a refreshing handcrafted beverage that combines cool cucumber juice, fresh mint leaves, zesty lime juice, and a touch of cane sugar. At $3.85, this revitalizing drink offers a perfect balance of crisp, herbaceous, and citrus flavors that complement any meal from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks). Explore the [full CAVA menu](//) for more options.
priceCalories: Priced at $3.85 for a 22 oz serving, the Cucumber Mint Lime contains 240 calories. With 61g of carbohydrates, 1g of protein, and 0g of fat, this refreshing beverage provides a sweet and energizing complement to your CAVA meal. The calorie content comes primarily from natural cane sugar balanced with fresh cucumber and lime juices.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets this drink apart is its unique combination of garden-fresh ingredients. The cucumber juice provides a clean, hydrating base while fresh mint adds an aromatic coolness. Lime juice contributes bright acidity, and cane sugar balances the flavors perfectly. Unlike typical sodas, this handcrafted beverage uses real, recognizable ingredients for an authentic taste experience.
nutritionFacts: Each 22 oz serving delivers 240 calories with a macronutrient breakdown of 61g carbohydrates, 1g protein, and 0g fat. The drink is naturally fat-free and provides quick energy from natural sugars. While higher in carbs due to cane sugar content, it offers more nutritional value than standard soft drinks. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) for detailed information.
whatsInside: The Cucumber Mint Lime contains four simple ingredients: cucumber juice for a refreshing base, fresh mint leaves for aromatic coolness, lime juice for citrus brightness, and cane sugar for balanced sweetness. This clean ingredient list contains no artificial flavors, colors, or preservatives, making it a more natural beverage choice compared to conventional sodas.
tasteLike: This beverage offers a refreshingly complex flavor profile. The first sip delivers cool cucumber notes followed by aromatic mint that tingles the palate. Lime juice adds a bright citrus punch while cane sugar rounds out the flavors with gentle sweetness. The overall taste is crisp, clean, and invigorating—perfect for quenching thirst alongside Mediterranean dishes.
customize: The Cucumber Mint Lime comes as a premixed beverage, so customization options are limited compared to build-your-own bowls on the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls). However, you can request less ice for more beverage or extra ice for maximum refreshment. Consider pairing it with different menu items to discover your ideal flavor combination throughout your meal.
pairsWell: This refreshing drink pairs beautifully with rich, savory items from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) like Grilled Chicken or Spicy Lamb Meatballs. The cucumber and mint help cleanse the palate between bites of bold Mediterranean flavors. It also complements creamy options from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads), cutting through richness with its bright, citrusy profile.
healthyChoice: With zero fat and made from real fruit and herb ingredients, the Cucumber Mint Lime offers a more wholesome alternative to artificial sodas. The 240 calories and 61g of carbs make it a moderate indulgence. While the cane sugar content is notable, the beverage provides hydration from cucumber juice and natural vitamin C from lime, making it a reasonable treat.
howToOrder: Order the Cucumber Mint Lime (22 oz) at any CAVA location by asking for it by name at the beverage station or register. It is available in both 16 oz and 22 oz sizes, with the larger size priced at $3.85. The drink comes pre-made and ready to enjoy. Find your nearest restaurant through [CAVA Locations](/locations) to try this refreshing beverage today.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Classic Lemonade (22 oz) at 360 calories, the Cucumber Mint Lime offers 120 fewer calories while providing more complex herbal notes. The Blueberry Lavender (22 oz) at 190 calories is a lower-calorie option but delivers a sweeter, fruitier profile. The Cucumber Mint Lime stands out for its savory-sweet balance and refreshing cucumber-mint combination that pairs exceptionally well with Mediterranean cuisine.
whoShouldTry: This drink is perfect for anyone seeking a refreshing, herbaceous beverage that goes beyond typical sodas or lemonades. Cucumber and mint lovers will appreciate the authentic flavors, while health-conscious diners will value the real ingredient list. It is ideal for those wanting a cooling complement to spicy or rich Mediterranean dishes without overwhelming sweetness.
worthTrying: Absolutely worth trying for its unique flavor combination and refreshing qualities. At $3.85 for 22 oz, you get a handcrafted beverage made with real cucumber, fresh mint, and lime juice. The clean ingredient list and complex flavor profile make it stand out from standard fountain drinks, offering a memorable taste experience that perfectly complements CAVA Mediterranean flavors.

faqs.a: The Cucumber Mint Lime is made with four simple ingredients: cucumber juice, fresh mint leaves, lime juice, and cane sugar. It contains no artificial flavors, colors, or preservatives.

faqs.q: How much does the Cucumber Mint Lime 22 oz cost?
faqs.a: The Cucumber Mint Lime in the 22 oz size costs $3.85 at CAVA locations. A smaller 16 oz size is also available at a lower price point.

faqs.a: Yes, the Cucumber Mint Lime is generally healthier than conventional sodas because it is made with real cucumber juice, fresh mint, and lime juice without artificial ingredients. However, it does contain 240 calories from cane sugar.

faqs.a: The Cucumber Mint Lime tastes crisp and refreshing with cool cucumber notes, aromatic mint, bright lime citrus, and balanced sweetness from cane sugar. It offers a complex, herbaceous flavor profile that pairs well with Mediterranean dishes.
